title: POST /automation saves an active flow with no start node; it fails only at trigger time with FLOW_NO_START_NODE
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ① product defect (an authoring door accepts a flow that can never run, reproduced through the API).

QA-source: #32135 · automation.trigger-status-contract · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

`POST /api/v1/automation` saves a flow that has no start node, with status `active`, and answers 200. The flow fails only when someone triggers it (422 `FLOW_NO_START_NODE`). Flows naming a position or queue that does not exist, or a notify channel that is not registered, also save with no advisory.

## Reproduction (framework ff04ad81, stock showcase, admin)

1. `POST /api/v1/automation` with a flow body whose `nodes` carry no `start` node and `status: 'active'` → 200.
2. Trigger it through the automation trigger door → 422 `FLOW_NO_START_NODE`.

- Expected: the save door refuses the shape that can never run (located, naming the missing start node), as the metadata save door refuses other invalid shapes; unknown positions, queues and channels at least warn at save.
- Actual: stored as active.

## Reach

The automation API door, and every authoring client on it (Studio, MCP, AI builders).

## Why it matters

AGENTS.md Prime Directive 12: wrong metadata is rejected at authoring, loudly. An AI author that writes a flow without a start node is told it succeeded and finds out only when the automation silently never fires.

## Reader

Triage first touch; the fix lands in `packages/services/service-automation` (the save path of `POST /automation`).

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack flow without start node` (863, open and closed), `FLOW_NO_START_NODE` (26): the existing cards are about the trigger door's status table (#9415, #9446, #9586); none about refusing the shape at save.
